issue.title: Fix checkfail in raw_ops.DenseBincount

repository.name: tensorflow
repository.description: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone

issue.body:
The API `raw_ops.DenseBincount` lacks validation of input to be vector. It does have checking for rank<=2 but not check for rank>0. Passing a scalar value causes checkfail with debug build.

Reported at #63068

body:
Hi @Sehun0819 ,

Thanks for findings. Proposed a fix in above PR. Thanks!

@Sehun0819,
The PR which was proposed for the API **raw_ops.DenseBincount** lacks validation of input to be a vector has been merged. Also the respective changes are also available in the respective files.

https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/pull/63114/files

**if (data.dims() <= 1)**  in [bincount_op.cc](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/pull/63114/files#diff-539b05632aa822e749c0d2d78ce544e17fb6f1eb510d1b180098acf60c0c9b3e) and **if (c->Rank(c->input(0)) == 1 || c->Rank(c->input(0)) == 0)** in [math_ops.cc](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/pull/63114/files#diff-285d834bdca6b7da7f6f950b0fa28d677591e9f5273068148f4f9425282be5b9)

Thank you!
This issue is stale because it has been open for 7 days with no activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs. Thank you.
